population.source: Tranco top 2000 sites, as they are - no commerce classifier
population.note: Publishing /.well-known/ucp is itself the signal; a site that does not publish one needs no classification.

method.request: one HTTPS GET of /.well-known/ucp per domain
method.timeouts: 2.5s on the first pass; every domain that timed out was asked again with 6s

finding: The one domain that publishes a profile serves it from wyzecom.myshopify.com - a Shopify storefront. Outside that one platform the protocol is not present at the top of the web.
